Agent Name: Validation_Expert
, Step Number: 6
, Reason for Mistake: They assumed Colville was the smallest county seat by land area and used its population to compute the difference without verifying the land-area criterion. The smallest county seat by land area in Washington is Cathlamet (Wahkiakum County), whose 2020 census population on data.census.gov is 560. Using Seattle’s 2020 census population of 737,015 and Cathlamet’s 560 gives the correct difference of 736,455, not 732,050.
